description: Brakes-only layer: 40 t on flat, parking brake ON, AMT drive-away interlock switched OFF, full throttle for 10 s in the launch gear. Tractor spring brakes + trailer braked through the hand control valve (park position) must hold the combination; the engine is pulled down to idle by the launch anti-stall instead of driving through.

checks.source: owner requirement 2026-11-10: 40 t must not move against the applied parking brake even under full engine torque in the launch gear
only tyre / driveline wind-up, no drive-through
no solver explosion against the brakes
